about: OpenFlowLM's models on the same machine and prompts, for comparison: a FastFlowLM fork that runs them on its own open (IRON / mlir-aie) NPU kernels. comparable_quants: the GGUF quants of the same model whose Artlite rows the charts pair with this one, first match first (q4nx is Q4_1 numerics, with Q8_0 lm_head and ssm_out in the Qwen3.5 containers). A note on a missing value says why it is missing.
version: 0.1.0-99fe7e4 (Atomic-Germ/OpenFlowLM-Next at 99fe7e4), oflm serve with every model on the open kernels, default prefill chunks of 4096, each model at its native context (Qwen3.8 27B at 131072: its KV at the native 262144 does not fit beside the weights with 16 GB to spare)
machine: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo, XDNA 2 NPU), NPU power mode turbo

method.ttft_s: streaming /v1/chat/completions with a Paul Graham essays prompt of n tokens, greedy, 128 tokens: client time to the first token (median of up to 3)
method.decode_tps: (tokens - 1) / time from the first to the last streamed token
method.engine_prefill_tps: OpenFlowLM's own figures: without the HTTP and streaming overhead
method.engine_decode_tps: OpenFlowLM's own figures: without sampling and streaming
